{"metadata":{"description":"Built by DeepSeek, for DeepSeek — a Swift-native macOS coding agent","id":"gh:1230068255","install_available":false,"language":"Rust","name":"deeptide","slug":"paean-ai/deeptide","topics":["codex-harness","coding-agent","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","macos","swift"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Built by DeepSeek, for DeepSeek — a Swift-native macOS coding agent"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"DeepTide"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Built by DeepSeek, for DeepSeek."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"An AI coding agent that flows through your codebase like a tide."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The name: DeepSeek + tide (terminal IDE)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Three flavors, same team"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| | DeepTide for macOS | DeepTide CLI (`deeptide`) | DeepTide CLI Rust (`deeptide-rs`) |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| **Form factor** | Native macOS app | Cross-platform terminal CLI | Cross-platform terminal CLI **+"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" native desktop GUI** (`--gui`) |
| **Runtime** | Swift 6 native binary, ~15 MB idle | Bun, ~50 MB r"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"esident | Native Rust binary, ~10 MB on disk, no runtime |
| **Platforms** | macOS 15+ | Linux · Win"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"dows · macOS | Linux · Windows · macOS |
| **Install** | `curl -fsSL https://deeptide.sh/install.sh "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"\| sh` | `bun add -g deeptide` (this package) | `npm install -g deeptide-rs` |
| **CLI name(s)** | D"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"eepTide.app | `deeptide`, `tide` | `deeptide-rs` |
| **Lineage** | 100% authored by DeepSeek V4 | Po"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"wered by open-source Zero CLI | Authored under `crates/` in this repo |
| **Best for** | macOS users"},{"id":"p8s8","text":" who want a tuned native experience | Existing users; richest plugin surface | Headless CI, slow lap"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"tops, single-binary deploys |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"This repository is the **community front door for all three** — docs, FAQ,
issue tracking — and is t"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"he home of two npm packages:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- `deeptide` — the current TypeScript/Bun CLI (forwards to
`@paean-ai/zero-cli`)
- `deeptide-rs` — t"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"he Rust CLI (ships a native binary
via GitHub Releases postinstall)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The two CLI packages **do not conflict** — they expose different binary
names (`deeptide`/`tide` vs "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"`deeptide-rs`) so you can install both and
switch between them freely while we mature the Rust port."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The Rust port lives under `crates/`. It is intended to grow
into the canonical cross-platform CLI ov"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"er time, but the `deeptide` package
will remain available as long as users find value in it — there "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"is no
forced migration."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"It also contains the open-source native local inference runtime under
`native/`: a hard-forked `ds4`"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" DeepSeek V4 Flash Metal engine plus
`dsgo`, the local OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible gateway intended "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"to pair with
DeepTide."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Install on macOS (recommended)"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"For Mac users, the recommended path is the native Deeptide build from
deeptide.sh. It downloads the "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"signed build for your
Mac architecture and installs both `deeptide` and the shorter `tide` command:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Then start with:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"If you want a native Mac terminal to pair with Deeptide, also try
Clide — a modern macOS terminal wi"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"th file explorer,
multi-pane layouts, drag-and-drop, and native voice input."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Install on Linux / Windows (Zero CLI alias)"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"> **Prerequisite:** Bun must be installed and on
> PATH. The CLI runtime requires it (matches the un"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"derlying
> Zero CLI). Bun does not
> replace your Node install — it sits alongside."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"On non-Mac systems, this npm package is the cross-platform DeepTide-flavored

installs the `deeptide` and `tide` aliases for a workflow close to Deeptide,
but it is n"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ot the Swift-native macOS build from `deeptide.sh`."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Two commands are installed; pick whichever your fingers prefer:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"You can also install the upstream package directly:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Build the macOS native app from source"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The macOS native build is open source at
paean-ai/deeptide (Swift). Most users
should install from d"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"eeptide.sh, but source builders can
inspect and build from the source tree when they need to modify "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"the native
runtime or local inference components."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Quick start (CLI)"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"DeepTide CLI talks to the **DeepSeek API** by default (matching the
DeepTide native app), and can al"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"so drive any Anthropic-protocol-compatible
endpoint via BYOK — Zhipu GLM, Volcengine, Paean, Qwen, M"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"oonshot,
self-hosted gateways, and so on."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"For the full configuration surface (settings.json schema, hooks,
permissions, MCP servers, sub-agent"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"s, model aliases) see the upstream
Zero CLI README, which is
the authoritative reference."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Desktop GUI (`deeptide-rs`)"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"The Rust port ships a **native desktop app** — a single Rust binary (egui, no
Electron/webview) that"},{"id":"p35s2","text":" is a thin window over the same engine the CLI uses. It
**fully shares the CLI's configuration, sess"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"ion history, and the entire tool
set** — there is no separate config to maintain:"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- **Same config** — reads the identical `~/.config/tide/settings.json` (and
project `.deeptide/setti"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"ngs.json`); set your provider/model/API key once and
both the CLI and the GUI pick it up.
- **Same s"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"essions** — conversations save to the same on-disk store, so a chat
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Built-in capabilities"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"DeepTide is an **agentic** coding assistant — the model plans, calls
tools, observes results, and ad"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"apts. Out of the box:"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"- **Multi-turn agentic loop** — plan → tool → observe → adapt
- **Streaming responses** — see the mo"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"del think and act in real time
- **30+ built-in tools** — file I/O, shell, web, tasks, MCP, scheduli"},{"id":"p39s3","text":"ng, sub-agents
- **25+ slash commands** — `/status`, `/cost`, `/diff`, `/init`, `/permission`, `/hoo"},{"id":"p39s4","text":"ks`, …
- **Permission modes** — default · accept-edits · plan · bypass
- **Hooks engine** — pre/post"},{"id":"p39s5","text":" tool, user-prompt, session, compaction shell hooks
- **Memory system** — persistent project memory "},{"id":"p39s6","text":"across sessions
- **Sub-agents from markdown** — define custom agents in your project
- **Custom sla"},{"id":"p39s7","text":"sh commands from markdown** — drop a `<name>.md` under
`.deeptide/commands/` (or `~/.deeptide/comman"},{"id":"p39s8","text":"ds/`) and run it as `/<name>`;
the body becomes a prompt with `$ARGUMENTS` / `$1`…`$11` substitution"},{"id":"p39s9","text":". Built-in
commands always take precedence.
- **Plan mode** — design before you code, get approval b"},{"id":"p39s10","text":"efore execution
- **Web research** — `/deep-seek <question>` uses the model's built-in
knowledge to "},{"id":"p39s11","text":"propose likely official/canonical URLs, then verifies them with
`WebFetch`. Optional `BRAVE_SEARCH_A"},{"id":"p39s12","text":"PI_KEY` / `SERPER_API_KEY` credentials
can improve source discovery, but are not required for URL-ba"},{"id":"p39s13","text":"sed research.
Sources are labeled `[verified]`, `[known]`, or `[unverified]`."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"The tool catalog, slash command set, hook event names, and model
aliases are kept aligned with the m"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"acOS native DeepTide app via the
`tide-spec`
shared interface contract — your hooks and muscle memor"},{"id":"p40s3","text":"y port between
the two."}],"truncated":true}
